name: prompt-chain-of-thought
description: Use when the user asks about chain of thought (CoT), think step by step, self-consistency, reasoning prompts, extended thinking or reasoning-effort settings. Produces a reasoning template with a parseable answer, a sampling choice and a with/without-CoT eval. Not for branching search over thoughts (use prompt-tree-of-thoughts) or choosing demonstrations (use prompt-few-shot).
